author: New China TV
description: The 77th International Astronautical Congress kicked off Monday in Antalya, Türkiye, gathering space researchers and industry representatives.
title: 77th Int'l Astronautical Congress opens in Türkiye's Antalya

author: New China TV
description: Mahmoud Tubasi, 60, returned to his house in Jalud, West Bank, escorted by the Israeli army after 70+ days away. Before the soldiers left, settlers set his home on fire. UN: about 3,800 Palestinians displaced by settler violence in 2026 alone.
title: A home in ashes, a livelihood lost amid settler attacks in West Bank

author: New China TV
description: Pakistan and Türkiye will provide military forces and capabilities and ensure their rapid deployment in Saudi Arabia in accordance with their commitments under the Mecca Alliance for Defense, the three countries said Monday, as Saudi Arabia faces escalating attacks from Yemen's Houthi group. #XinhuaNews
title: Pakistan, Türkiye agree to deploy forces, capabilities in Saudi Arabia amid Houthi threats

author: New China TV
description:
A spectacular "silver fish storm" is captivating tourists in Sanya, China's Hainan Province.
At Wuzhizhou Island, divers can plunge beneath the waves and swim alongside shimmering schools of fish, getting a close-up look at the dazzling underwater world.
title: "Silver fish storm" draws tourists to China's Sanya

author: New China TV
description: From Genshin Impact to Marvel's Avengers, more than 160 game, animation, and pop-culture franchises turned Shanghai's Fuxing Island into a real-life open-world adventure. #Shanghai #REDLAND2026 #ChinaTravel #Gaming #Animation
title: IP craze sweeps Shanghai's Fuxing Island

author: New China TV
description: Francis Halzen has been awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics 2026 for decisive contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and the discovery of high-energy neutrinos of astrophysical origin, the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences announced Tuesday. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Francis Halzen wins 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics

author: New China TV
description: Yunnan, once renowned as China's tea heartland, now boasts a thriving homegrown coffee industry. The rich aroma of Yunnan coffee beans reaches far beyond Chinese borders, diversifying product offerings across the Asia-Pacific coffee market. #GLOBALink
title: Brewing new trails, Yunnan coffee carries Chinese aroma across Asia-Pacific

author: New China TV
description: Tawila in western Sudan has called for stronger humanitarian assistance, as more than 6,000 displaced people flooded into the town over the past month.
title: Displaced families pour into Sudan's Tawila as challenges hinder int'l aid

author: New China TV
description: "It's been a large success for us, really pivoting our technology hubs here in China." Jerome Dorlack, president and CEO of Adient, a global leader in automotive seating, explained how innovation in China is benefiting his company's global business. #InnovateInChina
title: Why innovation in China matters to global business: Adient CEO

author: New China TV
description:
From drone shows and cliffside stays to open-air museums, new tourism experiences are taking center stage during China's National Day holiday.
Across the country, attractions are creating new ways to keep visitors engaged — and staying longer.
#ChinaTravel #NationalDay #HolidayTravel #Tourism #TravelChina
title: New tourism experiences boost holiday spending across China

author: New China TV
description: Beneath the waves off Zhangzi Island in northeast China's Liaoning Province, underwater photographer Wu Lixin has spent years documenting a hidden marine world that few human eyes ever see. Join Xinhua as we witness, through his lens, how his images help advance science, safeguard biodiversity, and deepen our bond with nature.
title: Into the deep blue: A photographer's journey beneath the waves

author: New China TV
description:
A group of Southeast Asian journalists and influencers got behind the wheel of Chinese EVs in Wuhan, central China's Hubei Province.
Their takeaway? China's EVs are making a big impact -- and "China is definitely leading the way."
title: Trendy China | Southeast Asian auto media impressed by Chinese EVs

author: New China TV
description:
From city sightseeing to country life.
Foreign tourists are going beyond the usual routes to experience China up close -- from paddling dragon boats in Guangdong to harvesting rice in Yunnan and exploring rural life in Xinjiang.
Not just seeing China. Experiencing it.

#ChinaTravel #TravelChina #RuralChina #ChinaTourism #CulturalExperience
title: From city sightseeing to country life: Foreign tourists seek deeper China experiences

author: New China TV
description:
5,000 drones illuminated the night sky where the Yangtze and Jialing rivers meet in Chongqing, southwest China, on Oct. 5, the fifth day of the National Day holiday.
The drone show added a spectacular touch to the city's night skyline.
title: 5,000 drones light up Chongqing's night sky

author: New China TV
description: Expressing gratitude for a donation of 100 books from 11 Chinese publishing houses, E. Aminudin Aziz, Director of the National Library of Indonesia, highlighted China's rapid development as an important attraction for Indonesian readers.
title: China's fast development attracts readers: Indonesia's National Library chief

author: New China TV
description: Russia on Monday condemned Japan's 27th sanctions package as illegitimate. On Oct. 2, Tokyo announced its 27th package of measures against Russia, affecting 33 Russian legal entities and nine individuals, as well as a number of companies abroad. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Russia condemns Japan's sanctions package as illegitimate

author: New China TV
description: Mozambican President Daniel Chapo has called for stronger agricultural cooperation between Mozambique and China, as a Chinese-invested farm helps increase grain yields and improve local farmers' livelihoods. #Mozambique #agriculture #cooperation #GLOBALink
title: Chinese-invested farm boosts agricultural production in Mozambique

author: New China TV
description:
"Flying traffic lights" are taking to the skies in China! 
Put into trial operation during the National Day holiday in Jinhua, Zhejiang, the drone-mounted traffic lights can be deployed to busy intersections on demand -providing temporary traffic control and voice announcements when traffic and crowds surge.
#FlyingTrafficLights #Drone #SmartTraffic #China #Traffic #Innovation #Tech
title: "Flying traffic lights" take to skies in China

author: New China TV
description: From the stages of southwest China's Sichuan Province to the villages of Kashgar, northwest China's Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, an inheritor of Sichuan Opera face-changing has planted the seeds of an ancient art in the hearts of children across 3,000 kilometers. Click to see how a traditional craft found new life, and new young hands, in Xinjiang.
title: Sichuan Opera face-changing takes root among Kashgar's youth
